title: Long-Term Care Cost Estimator
description: Compares what care actually costs across four settings: paid help at home, adult day care, assisted living, and a nursing home, correctly crediting facility settings (but not home settings) for avoided household costs, with a crossover-hours calculation and an insurance offset.
personas: adult child arranging care for a parent
data_vintage: 2026 (national median care costs, survey based, user-overridable)
